description: This file is a shell script designed for testing the failure handling of 'git p4 submit' commands within a git-p4 integrated environment. It contains various test cases simulating conflicts, cleanup procedures after failures, and different conflict resolution strategies.

methods.name: setup_conflict
methods.description: Helper function to set up a conflict scenario by cloning the depot and modifying files to induce conflicts during subsequent submissions.

search-terms: shell test script for p4 and git
